title: Black Friday pricing extended: Get lifetime access to AskAnyModel AI Pro for $27.97
excerpt: Why settle for one AI answer when you can compare six?
content_html:
TL;DR: Get a lifetime AskAnyModel AI Pro subscription for $27.97 with code SAVE12, down from $39.99 (reg. $499) through Dec. 6 at 11:59 p.m. PT.

Credit: AskAnyModel

$27.97
$499 Save $471.03

Choosing an AI model for a particular task can involve more trial and error than the task itself. You might ask ChatGPT a question, check Claude’s response, then open Gemini to see whether it comes up with something better. AskAnyModel AI puts that comparison in one place, allowing you to send a single prompt to as many as six models and view their answers side by side. Get it while it’s only $27.97 with code SAVE12 through Dec. 6 at 11:59 p.m. PT during our extended Black Friday sale.

This software provides users with access to more than 50 AI models, including GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Llama and Mistral. Seeing multiple responses together makes it easier to identify where models agree and where they differ. It’s a more practical way to compare results than relying on one chatbot or manually switching between separate subscriptions.

The Pro plan includes unlimited chats across 30 standard models, along with 500 monthly credits for premium models. Those credits replenish each month, providing ongoing access to flagship options without making that usage unlimited. The subscription also includes unlimited AI image generation across multiple models, which doesn’t draw from the premium credit balance. You can even switch models mid-conversation and follow responses as they come in.

For developers, researchers, marketers and other people who use AI regularly, the ability to compare outputs can be especially useful for accuracy, creativity, or finding the best way to begin a project. It also offers a way to consolidate access to multiple tools under one lifetime account instead of keeping track of several monthly subscriptions.
